technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the JDBC, Redis, and Kafka modules following the standard Spring XD module development patterns.
For U8 (HTTPS), update the Spring Boot dependency to 1.1.7 SNAPSHOT as specified, and configure SSL/TLS properties in the application properties.
For U3 (ZK security), utilize ZooKeeper Access Control Lists (ACLs) to restrict access to zNodes.
For U4 (Trigger abstraction), refactor the existing Trigger abstraction to expose a clear interface or abstract class that developers can implement, ensuring backward compatibility.
For U7 (E2E test fix), investigate the Grunt/Protractor configuration to resolve the socket hang up issue, likely by adjusting timeouts, port configurations, or process management.
assumptions: The developer has prior experience with Spring XD and the Spring Framework.
Testing environments for databases, Redis, and Kafka are already set up and accessible.
The 'grunt test:e2e' issue is a configuration or timing issue that can be resolved without rewriting the entire test suite.
Documentation for U5 will be in Markdown format and accompanied by a working sample module in the repository.
Effort estimates represent a single developer's work and do not include code review time by peers.

activities.activity_description: Design, implement, and test a native JDBC source module to ingest data directly from various databases, including configuration options for connection strings and queries.
Design, implement, and test a Redis sink module to ingest data into Redis, supporting basic connection and data serialization configurations.
Implement and configure ZooKeeper node security using ACLs to restrict access to zNodes for authorized users and applications.
Refactor the Trigger abstraction to allow developers to easily implement their own custom triggers, including updating documentation and interfaces.
Create a comprehensive example module and documentation to guide users in developing custom modules aligned with recommended practices.
Design, implement, and test a Kafka sink module to publish mass data into a Kafka broker, including topic and broker configuration.
Debug and fix the 'grunt test:e2e' socket hang up error to allow tests and server to run together in one process successfully.
Update the build file to use Spring Boot 1.1.7 SNAPSHOT and configure HTTPS for the XD Admin server endpoints.
